text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Day of the SWBC—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm in tip-top shape! I can run 
with everything I've got today! Let's do 
this!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
It changes your outfit automatically 
inside the simulator, so there was no need 
to go out of your way to put on your 
racing outfit...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
The mood is completely different! That's 
just how serious I am about this race!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Mun. ............Fully fired up.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Even you're wearing it...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Well, but if we're talking about being 
serious, I am too. I'll show them what my 
Trainer and I are made of...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
All three of us managed to have our 
trainees enter the race together!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
There were many twists and turns along the 
way, but we managed to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"That is the path those girls and I have 
walked together—our history, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if our history will one day 
become knowledge that serves to support 
someone else."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in order to make that happen, I'll 
need to keep delivering plenty of results 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! The curtain is finally rising 
on the SWBC!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume you train has achieved such 
spectacular growth up to this point...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Howevvver! The same holds true for the 
other Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"With everything you've got! Face those 
hand-picked, elite thoroughbreds and throw 
every single thing you have at them!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I believe this will be a grueling race 
that tests your abilities even more than 
the "WBC".

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, believe in the path you have 
walked so far, and please, seize that 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sent off by an even larger crowd than 
before, I stepped into the world of the VR 
simulator alongside <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you. Welcome to the 
SWBC.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
The incline is finally about to get steep. 
Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it looks like both of them are even 
more fired up than usual.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"It's alright. As long as you hold on to 
that desire to run, victory will find its 
way to you."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you see it clearly. The future 
of the Umamusume in your charge.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Let the race begin. ...Give it your all, 
and seize the summit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the SWBC finally begins!
